paper_title: SimSMoE Solving Representational Collapse via Similarity Measure
caption: : XMoE Routing Policy
model_annotation: The plot illustrates validation BPC as a function of training progress for two routing policies, with two lines labeled “XMoE Validating” and “SimSMoE Validating.” The x-axis is labeled “Training Steps” with a linear scale, spanning approximately 0 to 50 with a “(×10³)” multiplier indicated, and tick marks shown at regular 10-unit intervals (0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50). The y-axis is labeled “BPC” on a linear scale, ranging from about 1.10 up to about 2.25, with labeled ticks at roughly 1.25, 1.50, 1.75, 2.00, and 2.25. The “XMoE Validating” series is drawn as a yellow solid line with small star-like markers; it starts near 2.23 at 0k steps, drops steeply to around 1.55 by roughly 2–3k steps, then decreases more gradually to about 1.30 by ~10k and about 1.22–1.23 by ~20k, after which it continues a slow decline and fluctuates slightly around ~1.15–1.17 through ~50k. The “SimSMoE Validating” series is drawn as a magenta solid line with circular markers; it also starts near 2.23 at 0k, falls quickly to around 1.55 by ~2–3k, then trends downward to about 1.29–1.30 near ~10k and about 1.20–1.21 near ~20k, followed by a further gradual decrease with small variations, ending around ~1.12–1.14 by ~50k.
